reviews.text: I've never eaten such a nice and tender lamb stake before. The cooking was perfect.
The experience was 10/10, we where received by Cande the manager, the food was delicious, it transport me back to Argentina. Highly recommended!! ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
One of the best empanadas I ever tried ! And the meat so tender !! Candelaria, such a good manager 😊

(Translated by Google) Excellent service and quality. Candelaria served us; she was very friendly and helpful. We had breaded cutlets with French fries—everything was delicious! (Original) Excelente servicio y calidad. Nos atendió Candelaria , muy amable y servicial. Comimos milanesas con papas fritas, delicioso todo!
